query: SELECT retrieval_method, SUM(baseline_amount) AS sum_baseline_amount FROM cspaper WHERE uses_reranker = 'No' OR performance_on_hotpotqa = 'KILT-EM: 27.3 (T5-Base); KILT-EM: 31.1 (T5-XL)' OR baseline = 'Traditional RAG' GROUP BY retrieval_method;
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
